278785446.description: This lot includes approximately 4.9 pounds of mixed mineral and gemstone specimens. The collection features three groups: rough natural stones in various shapes and colors; a pile of small tumbled and polished gemstone chips in clear, black, yellow, purple, blue, and pink hues; and a selection of medium to large tumbled and polished stones in assorted colors such as green, black, red, and blue. The stones consist of semi-precious minerals including quartz, amethyst, jasper, agate, and potentially others. The condition varies from raw, uncut mineral chunks to smooth, polished stones. No specific brand or manufacturer is associated. Suitable for collectors, crafters, or educational use.
